description: ADO-BATCH conflict (another connection of the same process updates S of the middle staged row): a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID is opened on a read/write copy; a second Connection runs "UPDATE W SET S = 'ext' WHERE ID = 2"; S of rows 1, 2 and 3 is then set to "c1", "c2", "c3"; UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) and the Errors; each row's Status, ID, S, OriginalValue and UnderlyingValue; Filter = adFilterConflictingRecords (RecordCount, rows) and Filter none; Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues), the rows again, a second UpdateBatch (Errors) and the rows; then the stored rows through Execute. Asks which staged changes reach the file, the per-row reporting and what a second submission does.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
